messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: SEV2 - CI/Deploy blocked by third-party outage. GitHub Actions runners and GitHub Packages are failing across multiple regions. Paging oncall //alice for triage. Please acknowledge and post initial impact ASAP.

alice: acknowledged. seeing a huge spike of failed workflow runs for hotfix pipelines. error in Actions: 'could not resolve package' and 'failed to start runner'. :warning:

deploy-bot: Automated pipeline failure: hotfix/patch-123 -> build failed, exit code 128. Logs: `error: failed to fetch packages from ghcr.io`

ben: I'm on it. validating whether this is GitHub-wide or just packages. pinging status page: https://www.githubstatus.com/ — also checking our internal mirrors.

marta: Customer impact: several customers in EU/NA on Dedicated saw stalled deploys; application instances still serving existing traffic but we can't push hotfix builds. No evidence of inference errors yet, but inability to deploy fixes means degraded remediation capacity.

alice: summary of failure patterns: 1) GH Actions jobs stuck in pending/runner init 2) Pulls from ghcr.io and GitHub Packages return 502/timeout 3) Our repo actions for canary deploys failing at image push step.

ben: quick mitigation checklist: 1) confirm vendor outage (done) 2) fallback to prebuilt images in ECR/Artefacts (if available) 3) if critical hotfix needed, build artifacts locally and push to our internal S3 registry 4) consider rolling back to previous image for affected services.

eng-lead: Decision: If a security-critical hotfix is blocked we will do manual build+push to S3/ECR and perform a manual kubectl set image. Non-critical fixes wait for vendor resolution. Keep product and CS updated.

marta: CS note: notifying top 5 customers on the maintenance channel. tagging account execs for those on pending SLA.

alice: Doing immediate action: attempting to trigger local build on bastion runner and push to our ECR. If successful we'll trigger manual deploy. Posting commands now.

alice: ```bash
# build locally on bastion
git checkout hotfix/patch-123
make docker-build TAG=hotfix-patch-123
aws ecr get-login-password | docker login --username AWS --password-stdin 123456789012.dkr.ecr.us-west-2.amazonaws.com
docker tag myservice:hotfix-patch-123 123456789012.dkr.ecr.us-west-2.amazonaws.com/myservice:hotfix-patch-123
docker push 123456789012.dkr.ecr.us-west-2.amazonaws.com/myservice:hotfix-patch-123
# then update k8s
kubectl -n prod set image deployment/myservice myservice=123456789012.dkr.ecr.us-west-2.amazonaws.com/myservice:hotfix-patch-123
```

deploy-bot: Note: Our CI enforces signed artifacts from GitHub Actions. Manual pushes will bypass CI gating; eng-lead approval required.

ben: I'm enabling a temporary exception for the hotfix pipeline and will add an audit note. Also preparing a small script to mirror ghcr packages to our internal registry for immediate restores.

marta: Please track customer impact: number of blocked deploys, affected regions, and which customers requested hotfix. we should auto-generate a status update for platform-status.

alice: ben — handing off incident at T+15. next oncall is you. I'm going to run the local build now and will update with success/fail logs.

ben: ack. taking over. If the local build fails or ECR push fails, fallback plan: pull prebuilt artifact from our nightly S3 bucket (s3://redwood-artifacts/nightly/) and deploy that. if that also fails, we will open a support ticket with GitHub Priority Support and request runner/registry escalation and ETA.

eng-lead: please capture timeline and decisions in the incident doc (Runbook: third_party_outage.md#github-actions) and prepare a postmortem stub. Good work triaging so far.

alice: update: local build completed and image pushed to ECR successfully. starting manual deploy. kube rollout started.

deploy-bot: Manual deploy initiated by alice. Deployment myservice -> image 123456789012.dkr.ecr.us-west-2.amazonaws.com/myservice:hotfix-patch-123.

marta: CS update prepared: "We're currently experiencing delays to CI/CD due to a GitHub outage affecting Actions and Packages. We've applied a manual deploy for urgent hotfixes while GitHub resolves the issue. No customer inference degradation reported at this time." Sending now.

ben: rollout status: `kubectl -n prod rollout status deployment/myservice` -> rollout complete. Hotfix live. Marking this thread for follow-up until GitHub fully recovers.

incident-bot: Incident SEV2 transitioned to monitoring. Created follow-up ticket: INC-2026. Please add any remaining action items and assign owners. :white_check_mark:
